article.story: LEWISTON, N.Y. -- — London Maiden had 16 points in Detroit Mercy's 70-66 win against Niagara on Saturday. Maiden added eight rebounds for the Titans (2-6). Orlando Lovejoy added 12 points while going 4 of 9 and 4 of 4 from the free-throw line while he also had five rebounds. Lance Stone shot 1 of 4 from the field and 9 of 11 from the free-throw line to finish with 11 points. Justin Page led the way for the Purple Eagles (2-5) with 15 points and four assists. Reggie Prudhomme added 11 points and four assists for Niagara. Justin Hawkins had 10 points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
